records.source: The barcodes this run decodes, one entry per barcode, each naming the barcode, the reference CSV that names its sequences and the regex group it is captured by; an entry may be just the barcode name when a reference CSV is already named beside it. Default blank, which decodes the plate column, the guide and the plate row from column_csv, grna_csv and row_csv, exactly as every run did before this key existed. A set may hold one barcode or ten, and the regex has to name a group for every entry in it, so the run refuses a pattern that names fewer and says which barcode has no group.
records.translation: 本次运行要解码的条形码，每个条形码一个条目，每个条目指定条形码本身、列出其序列的参考 CSV 以及捕获它的 regex 分组；当参考 CSV 已在旁边指定时，条目可以只写条形码名称。默认留空，此时从 column_csv、grna_csv 和 row_csv 解码微孔板列、引导序列和微孔板行，与此键存在之前的每次运行完全相同。一个集合可以包含一个条形码，也可以包含十个，并且 regex 必须为其中的每个条目命名一个分组，因此当某个模式命名的分组较少时，运行会拒绝该模式并指出哪个条形码没有分组。

records.source: Raw intensity treated as background on the organelle 2 channel: the floor that remove_background_organelle 2 clips to zero, and the base of the organelleb_signal_to_noise product. Read it off a blank region of the image rather than guessing. Default 100.
records.translation: 在细胞器 2 通道上被视为背景的原始强度：remove_background_organelle 2 将低于该值的像素截为零的下限，也是 organelleb_signal_to_noise 乘积的基准值。请从图像的空白区域读取该值，而不要凭猜测设定。默认值 100。
